title: reCAPTCHA: Keep Bots Out of Sign-In, Registration and Forms | Orchard Core
description:
Bots guess passwords on sign-in pages, request reset emails on password pages, and send spam through contact forms.

The ReCaptcha and ReCaptcha Users features of Orchard Core add a reCAPTCHA checkbox to the Log in, registration and password pages, and a Re Captcha widget to the forms you build. You save your Site Key and Secret Key once, in the admin settings.

In this video:
• Why reCAPTCHA and how the check works
• Turn on the ReCaptcha and ReCaptcha Users features
• Save your Site Key and Secret Key
• The checkbox on the Log in page
• The registration and password pages
• Protect a form with the Re Captcha widget
• Check the answer with the Validate ReCaptcha workflow task
